{{Quote|I can't forget. I don't want to.|Lan|<ref name="Hostage" />}}
'''Lan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. The [[Standard day/Legends|day]] before Alderaan was [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], Lan went to Alderaan's sister planet [[Delaya/Legends|Delaya]] with his brothers, [[Mazi]] and [[Jez (Human)|Jez]], to watch a [[Smashball/Legends|smashball]] tournament. Following his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld's]] destruction, Lan and his brothers resorted to [[Thief/Legends|thievery]] in order to survive. They tried to rob [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], who was [[Mission to Delaya|visiting]] Delaya to help the Alderaanian refugee efforts, but were dissuaded by [[Ferus Olin]], a former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. When Organa was captured by a rogue [[Alderaanian faction]] that blamed her for their world's demise, it was Lan's brother Mazi who told Organa's companions where the faction's [[Unidentified school (Delaya)|hideout]] was. After Organa was rescued, Lan and his friends decided to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] as [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]].

==Biography==
===Early years===
{{Quote|There was a smashball tournament on Delaya. We got permission to go to the game, stay overnight on our own, then go back to Alderaan in the morning.''"<br />"''But that was the day&mdash;''"<br />"''Yeah. That was the day. So here we are. On our own.|Mazi and Han Solo on Alderaan's destruction|<ref name="Hostage" />}}
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Lan lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Hostage" /> In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the destruction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],</ref> the [[Standard day/Legends|day]] before Alderaan was [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], Lan went to see a [[Smashball/Legends|smashball]] tournament on [[Delaya/Legends|Delaya]]&mdash;Alderaan's sister planet&mdash;with his siblings [[Mazi]] and [[Jez (Human)|Jez]]. Despite Lan's young age, Mazi was able to convince their [[Parent/Legends|parents]] to allow them all to go. Their [[Lan's mother|mother]], who worried a lot, thought that the three of them were too young to go on their own. However, their [[Lan's father|father]] was easily convinced and the three of them made the trip.<ref name="Hostage" />

[[File:Alderaan.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Alderaan, Lan's homeworld]]
After Alderaan was destroyed, Lan and his brothers were left to fend for themselves, surviving on Delaya by becoming [[Thief/Legends|thieves]]. [[Ferus Olin]], a former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and another survivor of Alderaan, tried to dissuade them from turning to crime by giving them various small jobs to earn [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Hostage" />

When [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] made a [[Mission to Delaya|visit]] to Delaya to assist the refugee effort and recruit new members on behalf of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], Lan, along with Mazi and Jez, attempted to rob Organa. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who was one of the individuals accompanying Organa at that time, tried to placate the orphans but was unsuccessful. The standoff was broken when Olin arrived at the scene and disarmed Mazi&mdash;who was holding Organa at knife-point with a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]]&mdash;by shooting the vibroblade away with his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. After being told by Olin that he would stop giving them errands if they continued getting into trouble, Lan and his siblings ran away.<ref name="Hostage" />

The next day, a [[Memorial service on Delaya|memorial]] was held for the ones who died during Alderaan's destruction. Lan and his siblings went to the [[Unidentified chamber (Delaya)|chamber]] where the event was held but could not get inside because of the large crowd. Solo, who was also in attendance, spotted the orphans and quickly grabbed Mazi into a hold, making Jez and Lan to come to their big brother's aid. Both boys showed their determination and demanded that Solo let Mazi go despite their obvious fear. Solo, impressed by their bravery, released Mazi and befriended the group, offering [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] and a chance to go inside the chamber. With their guard lowered, Lan and his siblings narrated the story of how they came to be orphans on Delaya to Solo.<ref name="Hostage" />

===Joining the Alliance===
{{Quote|What gives, Captain Solo? Mazi said you'd be impressed.|Lan to Han Solo, on joining the Rebel Alliance|<ref name="Hostage" />}}
[[File:HanChillinAtChalmuns-ANH.jpg|thumb|right|175px|Han Solo, who Lan and his brothers looked up to]]
When Organa was captured by an [[Alderaanian faction]] that blamed her for the destruction of their world, Lan's brother Mazi provided Solo and Organa's other companions the location of the ringleader's [[Unidentified school (Delaya)|hideout]]. The information eventually led Solo and the others to successfully rescue Organa from the Empire, to whom she was handed over by the faction for a reward. Olin surmised that the orphans, who were willing to do anything for credits and knew where the faction ringleaders were hiding, might have been hired by the faction to rob and capture Organa previously.<ref name="Hostage" />

After Organa's rescue, Lan and his siblings spoke with a Rebel recruiter and decided to join the Alliance as [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]. They eagerly told Solo&mdash;whom they had grown quite fond of&mdash;the news, hoping to impress him. The orphans were scheduled to be shipped that night and Solo wished them luck, although he thought Lan and his brothers were too young to serve in the Alliance.<ref name="Hostage" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Mazi can talk anyone into anything.|Lan about Mazi|<ref name="Hostage" />}}
Despite his young age, Lan displayed bravery and loyalty to his brothers. When Han Solo confronted Lan and his siblings on Deyala, Lan, along with Jez, refused to leave Mazi, who was in Solo's grasp, behind. It was Solo's observation that they were terrified of him and were putting on a brave front, which earned his grudging admiration. As a result of Alderaan being destroyed, Lan and his brothers became orphans overnight and had to look out for each other. Mazi became the unofficial leader due to his age, and Lan, being the youngest of the three, started looking up to Mazi with something close to hero worship. When Solo did not turn them in to the authorities for trying to rob Organa, the orphans began yearning to impress the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]].<ref name="Hostage" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lan was a character created by author [[Alex Wheeler]] for the [[2008]] novel ''[[Rebel Force: Hostage]]'', the second volume in the ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Force]]'' series.<ref name="Hostage" />
